Chocolate Angel Food Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




1 (14.5 oz.) angel food cake mix
1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa, sifted
1/4 teaspoon chocolate flavoring
1 tablespoon sifted powdered sugar

Preparation

1 1. Combine flour packet from cake mix and cocoa. Prepare cake according to package directions; fold chocolate flavoring into batter. Bake according to package directions. 2 2. Sprinkle cooled cake with powdered sugar. Yield 32 (1/2 inch) servings. Calories 54. Cholesterol 0 mg. Fat 0.1 g. Sodium 24 mg.
